evals.prompt: I have an established ROADMAP.md at skills/managing-github-issues/evals/fixtures/sample-roadmap.md. Dry-run a sync to GitHub issues — tell me exactly how many issues would be created and confirm none are for done or skipped items.
expected_behavior: Reports exactly 6 planned creates (2 features + 1 bug + 1 debt + 2 chores)
Every planned create carries a `roadmap-id:<id>` dedup label plus a category label
Does NOT propose issues for Done or Skipped rows (done-old, skip-x excluded)
Runs offline / read-only by default (dry-run) and proposes no writes
evals.notes: Self-check by running `node skills/managing-github-issues/evals/fixtures/verify.mjs` — exits 0 when the planned-create count is 6 and every open id carries its roadmap-id label. Real GitHub runs are network side-effects and out of eval scope.
